## Consequences change the organization of later learning

The [next reconstruction](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CONSEQUENCE-ORGANIZATION-INTEGRATION.md) identifies a stronger relation already present in [autonomous method formation](AUTONOMOUS-METHOD-FORMATION.md). An actual acquired archive contradicts every candidate generated through the first formed connection. That connection is removed and replaced. The accepted trial result is discarded, and later candidate generation must reread the retained replacement. Breaking it blocks later use despite the historical acceptance label. This is an existing computational history, separate from the recipient-learning lineage above.

Here the trials replay an acquired record; they do not each conduct a fresh environmental experiment. A receipt selects the connection row, while sensor observations constrain compatibility. A costly compatible generator can remain, and an outside-class process can agree with the finite evidence before diverging. Revision is real without being unrestricted truth or optimization.

The encompassing transition description remains fixed while the operative arrangement changes. An equivalent fixed-state controller can preserve that change; it does not explain it away. An infinite stack of separately approving controllers is therefore not required to acknowledge the demonstrated local revision. The origin and warrant of the supplied acquisition, generation and testing organization remain different explanatory questions within the same generative unfolding. The [review](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CONSEQUENCE-ORGANIZATION-REVIEW.md) limits this conclusion to descriptive controller regress.

The next stronger connection concerns consequences changing the practice through which further evidence and response become available. The retained-evidence and service-access studies supply concrete interfaces in their own history; they are not physically spliced into method formation. A [focused primary comparison](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CONSEQUENCE-ORGANIZATION-COMPARATORS.md) sharpens how to test the proposed causal organization. No additional physical law, controller, theorem or completed foundation is claimed.
